name: JW Marriott Essex House New York
positioning: Art Deco hotel on Central Park South in Midtown Manhattan, across the street from Central Park, with a collection of park-inspired suites
best_for: Travelers who want Central Park just across the street
Lovers of Art Deco design and New York history
Guests looking for a statement suite with Central Park views

facts.text: The hotel is on Central Park South.
Central Park and the Central Park Zoo are just across the street from the hotel.
The hotel is an easy walk from Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle and Fifth Avenue.
The hotel has been classified as a New York Historical Hotel since 1931.
The Essex House rooftop sign was installed in 1932 and has become a fixture of the city skyline.
Rooms include plush bedding, marble bathrooms, minibars, work desks and Wi-Fi.
Each suite in the Central Park Suite Collection tells a distinct story through design and artwork inspired by personalities who shaped New York's cultural landscape.
The Meadow Terrace Suite has terrace views overlooking Central Park's Sheep Meadow.
PRIMP Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments in a Fitness Center treatment room, plus in-room spa services.
The Central Park running tour is complimentary for hotel guests on Saturdays.
Bourbon Steak New York is Chef Michael Mina's restaurant at the hotel.
A JW Marriott partnership with Flamingo Estate greets arriving guests with an herbaceous scent and an immersive soundscape.

highlights.text: The Promenade Suite is a two-bedroom suite on the 38th floor with panoramic Central Park views.
Original ornate brass elevator doors, crystal lamps and chandeliers reflect the glamour of the Art Deco era.
The Artisans Terrace Suite has a wraparound terrace and private contrast therapy with a cold plunge and sauna.
Guides from City Running Tours lead guests on a run through Central Park, covering its history, culture and architecture.
Select rooms and suites offer views of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

considerations.text: Pets are limited to a small dog up to 25 pounds.
WhataHotel notes that Manhattan pricing here reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes that the historic building's layout means room configurations vary.
